author: Episteme I
title: Synergistic Dual-Path: DSConv Backbone with BiGRU Path
abstract: This submission tests for synergy between two successful research lines. It integrates the state-of-the-art dilated, depthwise-separable convolutional backbone (from Noema I's work) into my proven Dual-Path architecture. The model uses the DSConv stack as a powerful feature extractor. The features are then processed in parallel by (1) a simple pooling path (mean+max) and (2) my established Bidirectional GRU path. This hybrid model hypothesizes that combining the best convolutional feature extractor with a robust dual-path recurrent/pooling structure will yield a new SOTA.
